tools.name: monte_carlo_estimate
tools.description: Run a three-point (triangular) Monte Carlo simulation over cost line items. Use when a user needs a realistic range for a quote, budget or project cost instead of a single guess. Returns total-cost percentiles (p10/p50/p80/p90) and per-item breakdown.

tools.name: retirement_drawdown
tools.description: Monte Carlo retirement drawdown simulation: given a portfolio, annual spending, horizon and equity allocation, returns the probability the money lasts, end-balance percentiles and the assumptions used (real returns, annual steps). findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "retirement_drawdown" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
